protocol.waveform_noise: IID real Gaussian samples; sigma=fraction*stronger terminal maximum phase RMS per V/I family over ideal capture.
protocol.seed_policy: seed+100*profile_index+10*fault_index; matched perturbations across timing modes/noise levels.
protocol.timing_jitter: DAT encoding jitter <=5us, not physical sample-aperture jitter.
protocol.clock_skew: R CFG start/trigger +1418s; waveform/local support unchanged; not physical drift recovery.
protocol.review: Known synthetic one-step identity; no autonomous field pairing.

limits: Bounded synthetic waveform/ASCII parsing experiment, not EMT/instrument reconstruction, UTC synchronization, drift correction, calibrated confidence, exhaustive coverage or field acceptance.
